method.segments: day < 2026-07-01 -> llm_in_sample, else clean_holdout; pooled = all days; the 2026-11-10 pilot day is clean_holdout
method.H-MD1: per symbol-day TEST-half (12-24 UTC) estimates from laws/<SYM>.json tests: order-sign ACF power-law gamma, order-sign lag-1 ACF, print-size CSN tail index zeta, event-duration expmix3 weights (components ordered fastest first); ICC(1) one-way random effects with symbol as the group (unbalanced n0), symbols with >= 2 days; mixture trait = mean of the three weight ICCs; 95% CI by a bootstrap over symbols (B = 2000); a trait passes if ICC > 0.5 and CI lower > 0.3; supports = >= 3 of 4 traits; p = 3rd smallest of the trait p's (P*(ICC <= 0.5)); robustness: FIT half, symbol-days with >= 20k prints
method.H-MD2: FIT-half activity rows (research.population_simulator_study._half_measures): W = sigma_day x P V_day; rate = log orders/s, impact = log Kyle lambda (mid proxy, bp per USD 1k; rows with lambda <= 0 dropped), depth = log median 25 bp book depth (L2 symbols, symbol-days whose 25 bp band is truncated in > 50% of the 1 s states dropped; descriptive); model y = 1 + log W + alt + tradfi + day FE; LOO R^2 leaving out all days of one symbol; bootstrap over symbols (B = 300) for P*(LOO R^2 <= 0.5); interaction model adds day x log W, Wald chi2 of the interactions with CR1 covariance clustered by symbol; supports = LOO R^2 > 0.5 for rate and impact and Wald p > 0.05 for both; p = max of the two LOO bootstrap p's
method.H-MD3: symbol-days with >= 20k prints: order-sign ACF power law preferred on held-out TEST lags (fit on FIT, as H-MS3) and 0 < gamma_TEST < 1; share vs 0.8 (one-sided binomial); pooled Hurst = mean over the same symbol-days of the DFA-1 Hurst of 1 s signed notional (TEST half), 95% CI by a bootstrap over days (B = 2000); supports = share >= 0.8 and CI lower > 0.5; p = max(binomial p, P*(mean H <= 0.5))
method.H-MD4: L2 symbol-days whose FIT-half 1 s states have spread > 1.5 ticks in >= 25% (qualifying, known before TEST); gain = OOS R^2 (TEST) of the FIT-estimated per-symbol regression with log spread minus without (micro_days.METHOD spread_vol), h = 5 and 15 min; supports = >= 10 qualifying symbol-days and gain > 0 on >= 70% of them at both horizons; p = max over h of the one-sided binomial p vs 0.7 (sign test vs 0.5 reported)
method.H-MD5: daily Diebold-Yilmaz net directional connectedness (full UTC day, primary; halves reported) of log 1 m RV for the fixed H-MS6 token set; supports = ETH net > 0 and SOL net > 0 on >= 80% of days; p = max of the binomial p's vs 0.8; BTC vs ETH: mean of net_BTC - net_ETH over days with a day bootstrap CI (reported, not in the success line)
method.H-MD6: L2 symbols; real 3 s grid from book_1s (mid at candle close, spread = mean of the 3 one-second states, 25 bp depth at close) and trades_1s (buy / sell notional, prints, high / low); facts as H-SIM2 / H-MS8 on the TEST half, envelope = [2.5, 97.5]% of the class median under a 1 h block bootstrap (B = 300); v1 = flow_sim_v1 built and calibrated on the FIT half exactly as population_simulator_study.stage_symbol_one (laws = that day's FIT laws, spread / tick regime / shape targets from the FIT-half grid instead of pre-TEST flow_3s days, trade statistics from the order stream); v0 = flow_sim.FlowSim.fit on the FIT-half grid; 10 paths each of the TEST ok-candle count; class-day = (day, class) with >= 2 symbols; count = facts inside (kurtosis, |r| ACF, flow ACF, impact, spread median AND p90); supports = v1 > v0 on >= 70% of class-days and majors v1 >= 4/5 on >= 50% of days; p = max of the binomial p's vs 0.7 and 0.5
method.holm: Holm over the six MD summary p's (only at the final batch); supports needs the criterion and Holm p < 0.05
method.recording: early record only for a share criterion already lost given the remaining planned days ('contradicts'); everything else after the last batch

summary_line: MD1 ICC gamma 0.31, acf1 0.31, zeta 0.23, mix_weights 0.24; MD2 LOO R2 rate 0.93 impact 0.62 Wald p 0.000/0.005; MD3 502/637 power-law, Hurst 0.541 [0.534, 0.549]; MD4 qualifying 32, gain>0 16/32 (5m) 16/32 (15m); MD5 net>0 ETH 15/15 SOL 15/15; MD6 v1>v0 28/44 class-days, majors>=4/5 0/16

aggregate_schema.layout: data/research/micro_days/<YYYY-MM-DD>/{trades_1s,book_1s,orders}/<SYMBOL>.parquet, laws/<SYMBOL>.json, sim/<SYMBOL>.json, day_stats.json, qa.json; a day is usable only if qa.json has verified.ok = true (micro_days.processed_days()); FIT = 00:00-12:00 UTC, TEST = 12:00-24:00 UTC; segment = llm_in_sample if date < 2026-07-01 else clean_holdout
aggregate_schema.trades_1s: one row per UTC second WITH at least one print (sparse: missing seconds had no trade; reindex to 86400 rows yourself). ts Int64 = second OPEN in epoch ms (the bar covers [ts, ts + 1000)); open/high/low/close Float64 = first/max/min/last print price; vwap Float64; buy_vol/sell_vol Float64 = taker-buy / taker-sell base quantity; buy_notional/sell_notional Float64 = USD (price x size); n_trades/n_buy/n_sell Int32 = prints; n_orders/n_buy_orders/n_sell_orders Int32 = taker orders (consecutive same-ms same-side prints merged, counted in the second of the order's first print). Signed flow = buy_notional - sell_notional. Point in time: a bar is known at ts + 1000
aggregate_schema.book_1s: L2 symbols only (BTC ETH SOL XRP DOGE HYPE CARV KAS ATOM NVDA QQQ XAU; NVDA/QQQ/XAU absent before their listing); one row per second, dense from the first message (forward-filled when no update). ts Datetime(ms, UTC) = END of the 1 s bin of the push time: the book state as of ts (known at ts); cts Int64 = matching-engine ms of the last applied message; bid1, ask1, bid1_size, ask1_size, mid, rel_spread_bp = (ask1 - bid1) / mid x 1e4; depth_{bid,ask}_{5,10,25} = USD notional within 5/10/25 bp of mid per side; imb_5, imb_10 = (bid - ask) / (bid + ask) depth at 5 / 10 bp; span_bid_bp, span_ask_bp = distance of the deepest of the 200 levels from mid (a depth band wider than the span is TRUNCATED: BTC ~2.7 bp, so BTC 5/10/25 bp depths are lower bounds); n_updates Int32 = messages in the bin; symbol Utf8. Join to trades_1s with book ts = trades ts + 1000 (state at the end of the trade second)
aggregate_schema.orders: one row per taker order: ms Int64, side Int8 (+1 buy / -1 sell), size, notional (USD), n_prints Int32, first_price, last_price
aggregate_schema.laws/<SYM>.json: halves{fit,test} in the schema of data/models/microstructure_laws/params_2026-11-10.json; tests (held-out comparisons); activity{fit,test} (W, sigma_day, orders_per_s, Kyle lambda, ...); tick (minimum price increment of the day)

## Changes since batch 2 (16 days; read this first)

- **Processing.**
  - The job was killed by a machine sleep (~08:02-11:05 UTC) partway through 2026-07-03. 2026-05-11 and 2026-06-21 had already been verified and their raw files deleted before the interruption, and they were not touched again.
  - The rerun at 11:10 UTC used the new resume mode (micro_days.resumed_task): it reused 16 finished symbol-days of 2026-07-03 and the cached, atomically downloaded archives, then finished 07-03, 08-16 and 10-02. All 5 days are verified and data/raw/batch_3 is deleted.
  - The 'batch days' line under 'Processing and storage' lists only the 3 days of the resumed run. The full log is logs/micro_batch_3.log.
  - Storage: lake plus research is 3.07 GB; micro_days is 1.79 GB.
- **New universe.** 2026-05-11 is missing GRAM, BZ and CRWV (not yet listed) and 2026-06-21 is missing GRAM. NVDA, QQQ and XAU books exist on both days.
- **H-MD6 recorded: contradicts (clean_holdout and pooled).** Majors reach 4/5 facts inside the envelope on 0/10 holdout days and 0/16 days pooled. Even if every remaining planned day passed, the share would be at most 9/19 = 0.47 and 15/31 = 0.48, below the registered 50%. v1 still beats v0 on 28/44 class-days (0.64). llm_in_sample is not locked (0/6 majors with 6 days left -> at most 0.5), so it waits.
- **H-MD2.** The in-sample segment no longer meets its criterion (the interaction Wald test now rejects there too). Pooled Wald p is 0.0003 for rate and 0.005 for impact; the rate LOO R^2 is 0.93.
- **H-MD3.** Pooled share is 502/637 = 0.788 (holdout 0.80, in-sample 0.766). Hurst is 0.541 [0.534, 0.549].
- **H-MD4.** Gain > 0 on 16/32 qualifying symbol-days at both horizons (in-sample 1/9 at 5 min). It is close to a coin flip, but not yet locked.
- **H-MD5.** ETH and SOL are net transmitters on 15/15 days.
- **H-MD1.** ICCs are 0.23-0.31; none passes.
